author: isaslash
quote: This is such a great remake of arguably one of the best games of all time. The original already did groundbreaking work, but the remake brought in stunning visuals and expanding characterizations. A perfect experience
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: isaslash
quote: I'm really disappointed. Waited over a decade for this and visually it looks great, but the gameplay is not it. It feels clunky and I hate being locked at 30fps in 2026. The story is also not very strong.
